chapters.title: Discussions on Israel

summary: This class features reflections from participants on an SCA trip in Israel. The speakers discuss their sessions on implementing what they learned in Israel back home and share their experiences with activities like hiking, laser tag, and dancing.
questions: What activities were included in the SCA trip?
How can students implement what they learned in Israel back home?
What is the importance of Jewish unity according to the speakers?
What was the highlight of the trip for the participants?
